answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 41043 Country: India Title: Is "Tahrem" name good for girl Question: Is "Tahrem" name good for girl? Answer ID: 41043 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1404/892/L=1433) It is not good to keep the name Tahreem for a girl. Choose any name from amongst the names of holy wives, holy daughters or Sahabiyat for your daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
